intro.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
intro.text: Jin, welcome to Meridian. A dust front is closing in. Check the habitat terminal, restore our collectors, and get the crew behind a sealed airlock. We are counting on you.

diagnosis.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
diagnosis.text: Collectors are contaminated, and the reserve battery is dead. I can clean the array, salvage the rover battery, and rebuild the power connection. The clock is running.

panel-clean.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
panel-clean.text: Collector output is rising. Keep going. Every watt gives our oxygen recycler more time.

solar-complete.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
solar-complete.text: All three collectors are online. Good work. The rover has a reserve battery in its rear service bay. Recover it before the front arrives.

battery.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
battery.text: Reserve battery recovered. Taking it to the power junction. The habitat still needs a stable connection.

install.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
install.text: Battery seated. The three connectors must read one, two, three. Then I can engage the relay.

repair.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
repair.text: Habitat power is stable. Return to the diagnostic terminal and choose our reserve allocation. Oxygen first, or keep the science systems running. Your call.

life.speaker: Luca Moreau · Medic
life.text: Oxygen reserves are full. That gives everyone a margin. The front is here. Get to the airlock, Jin.

research.speaker: Luca Moreau · Medic
research.text: Science systems remain powered, but we have limited oxygen. We can get through this if you reach shelter quickly. The front is here.

storm.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
storm.text: Visibility is collapsing. Stop exterior work and return to the marked airlock. Whatever is unfinished, we deal with it later. Get inside.

shelter.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
shelter.text: You are inside. Water tanks are shielding the sleep area. Use the shelter console to seal the airlock and account for the crew.

sealed.speaker: Luca Moreau · Medic
sealed.text: Seal confirmed. All four of us are here. Stay calm, watch the reserves, and transmit our status when the front has passed.

prepared.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
prepared.text: Meridian to Earth. All four crew are safe. Collectors restored, power stable, oxygen reserves secure. Today, preparation made the difference. Mission Control Jr. holds.

survived.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
survived.text: Meridian to Earth. All crew survived, but our reserves are depleted. We must review the unfinished preparations before the next mission. We made it. Barely.

evacuated.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
evacuated.text: Meridian to Earth. Initiating emergency evacuation. The outpost cannot sustain life support. We will preserve the mission logs so the next crew can learn from our decisions.

elena.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
elena.text: A good mission protects its people. Look at the diagnostics, prepare with evidence, and finish one task at a time. I will keep the crew ready for shelter.

amara.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
amara.text: Our recycler depends on steady power. Clean collectors help now. A working battery helps when sunlight disappears. Restoring both gives us a much better chance.

luca.speaker: Luca Moreau · Medic
luca.text: Fatigue makes small mistakes dangerous. Take a breath, check your connectors, and do not trade away the oxygen margin without understanding the cost.

water.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
water.text: These water tanks store our drinking supply. Around the sleep area, they also add shielding. Here, every kilogram has more than one job.
